parse: Parse a query string into an object, splitting pairs on `separator` (default `&`) and key/value on `delimiter` (default `=`). `+` decodes to a space, keys and values are percent-decoded, and repeated keys collect into an array.
stringify: Serialize an object into a query string, joining pairs with `separator` (default `&`) and key/value with `delimiter` (default `=`). Array values produce one pair per element.
